content.user_title: Create ACE Step Music on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Music teams need quick drafts, repaired sections, and extended tracks without complex audio tooling. This skill guides ACE Step generation, inpainting, and outpainting through the RunComfy CLI.
actual_capabilities: Selects between ACE Step text-to-audio, ACE Step 1.5, audio inpaint, and audio outpaint routes.
Builds runcomfy CLI inputs for tags, lyrics, duration, seed, and output directory.
Explains when to use base ACE Step versus ACE Step 1.5 for multilingual vocals.
Guides time-based inpainting with start and end positions for a track segment.
Guides outpainting settings to add intro, outro, or both to an existing track.
limitations: Requires the runcomfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Audio source URLs for edit workflows must be HTTPS links that RunComfy can access.
Single calls are limited to the endpoint duration rules described by RunComfy.
It does not verify music rights, lyric rights, or commercial licensing for user content.

use_cases.title: Draft Background Tracks
use_cases.description: Generate low-cost instrumental drafts from genre, mood, instrument, and BPM tags.

use_cases.title: Create Multilingual Song Versions
use_cases.description: Use ACE Step 1.5 with structured lyrics to test vocal ideas in different languages.

use_cases.title: Extend Game Audio Loops
use_cases.description: Outpaint a short hook into a longer intro, loop bed, or ending cue.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Instrumental Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step to create a 60 second instrumental track. Style: [genre]. Mood: [mood]. Instruments: [instruments]. BPM: [tempo].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step 1.5 to generate a [duration] song with [language] vocals. Tags: [style tags]. Lyrics sections: [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge].

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Track Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-inpaint on this HTTPS audio URL: [url]. Replace from [start] to [end] seconds with [style and lyric instructions].

prompt_templates.title: Extend and Version a Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-outpaint on [url]. Add [seconds] before and [seconds] after, keep [style], and use seed [seed].

output_examples.input: User asks for a 90 second lo-fi instrumental with soft drums and rhodes piano.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends ACE Step base, organizes tags, sets an instrumental lyric marker, and directs output to a local folder.

output_examples.input: User provides a song URL and asks to replace 20 to 40 seconds.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-inpaint, maps the edit window, preserves matching style tags, and explains that the source URL must be accessible.

output_examples.input: User wants a 30 second hook extended into a full cue.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-outpaint, suggests intro and outro durations, and warns about the four minute total target limit.

best_practices: Use specific tags for genre, mood, instruments, vocal type, tempo, and production texture.
Use ACE Step base for cheap drafts, then move to ACE Step 1.5 when vocal quality matters.
Keep user-provided audio URLs and lyrics limited to material the user has rights to use.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the model to copy a living artist or copyrighted song directly.
Do not run setup commands without the operator reviewing package source and account requirements.
Do not use broad tags like music or nice song when a production style is required.

faq.question: Does this skill generate music directly inside Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and runs RunComfy CLI workflows that call ACE Step endpoints.

faq.question: Which ACE Step endpoint should I use for vocals?
faq.answer: Use ACE Step 1.5 for multilingual vocals and stronger structured lyric handling.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing song?
faq.answer: Yes. Audio-inpaint replaces a time range, and audio-outpaint extends before or after an existing audio file.

faq.question: Does it need an API token?
faq.answer: Yes. RunComfy authentication is required through runcomfy login or the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable.

faq.question: Can it use local audio files?
faq.answer: The documented edit routes expect HTTPS audio URLs that RunComfy can reach.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide style tags, lyrics or instrumental intent, duration, seed needs, and any edit timestamps.
